t: Opinions on Salomon Shadowfit bindings? | Snowboarding Forum - Snowboard Enthusiast Forums
s: I feel like Shadowfit would work if the boot-binding interface is snug and there's little excess width in the heelcup. If there's any discrepancy like there was in my case, I think you'd potentially have as miserable a time as I did with them. I don't regret the experience - once again, it's Australia, so if you want to check something out you have to buy it - but despite spending $400+ for bindings I absolutely didn't need, with tech that intrigued the shit outta me, and researching and deliberating then deliberating some more...

t: talk shadowfit to me, baby | Snowboarding Forum - Snowboard Enthusiast Forums
s: The flexible heelcup meant that bulkier heels were crammed in there, causing pressure that made them really painful after 4-5 laps (see my review thread for more details). It's definitely worth testing first. Effing great bindings for my type of riding. Wouldn't change them for anything else. Doesn't mean it'd work for everybody but shadowfit is amazing for me.
